records.text: Benjamin Netanyahu, Erika Kirk, and Ben Shapiro were scheduled to film something together in Palm Beach, but it was canceled at the last second.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: There was a schedule a few weeks ago for Bibi (Benjamin Netanyahu), Erika Kirk, and Ben Shapiro to film together something. Maybe it was supposed to be for the Super Bowl. I don't know, but it got canceled at the last second. They were filming something in Palm Beach. And it got canceled last second.

verification.notes: The allegation originated with an unnamed tip to Owens. Live research found no confirmation or response from Netanyahu, Shapiro, Kirk, or Daystar and no schedule or cancellation record. Absence of evidence is not direct contradiction, so false is not warranted.
